script_template: #SBATCH --mail-type=FAIL,TIME_LIMIT_90  ### possible values (NONE, BEGIN, END, FAIL, REQUEUE, ALL)

image.title: docker image
image.description: The docker image containing the flow code

num_nodes.title: number of compute nodes
num_nodes.description: The number of nodes to be allocated per flow run

num_processes_per_node.title: number of processes per node
num_processes_per_node.description: number of MPI processes per node. Usually equal to the number of CPUs per node.

max_walltime.title: maximum walltime
max_walltime.description: The maximum walltime allocated to a flow run. Set sensibly, this can help starting SLURM jobs with higher priority.

queue.title: SLURM queue
queue.description: The SLURM partition to send jobs to. Depending on the cluster configutation, this has implications on priority, walltime, execution node types, etc.
